title: Frontbook fee validation Manifest
description: Durable record of every Run, per Surface. A bare invocation of the skill advances this file. Written through on every stage transition, never only at the end. One eyeball at data/manifest.json for a code shows every Surface's status - never just the CMA's.

seeded_from.description: data/run-matrix.csv@<sha256>. The skill refuses to start if the matrix no longer hashes to this; a changed matrix requires a deliberate --reseed.

database.description: Identity of the Postgres the Campaign ran against. An Attempt from a destroyed database is unreproducible, not trustworthy.

reachability.description: direct: URL-selectable by strategy UUID. mla_forced: no UUID; applied under the non-MLA twin with the local MLA stub forcing a positive TransUnion MLA report.

strategy_uuid.description: null for mla_forced codes, which have no UUID by design

expected.description: Copied from the matrix row at seed time so an Attempt stays interpretable if the matrix later changes.

surfaces.description: One entry per Surface (CONTEXT.md), always all five - a Surface this code cannot reach yet still appears, as not_applicable/not_implemented/blocked, so a Run passing on the CMA and unrun on everything else cannot read as green (ROADMAP 2.5).

status.description: DERIVED from the newest Attempt where one exists, never authored independently. blocked/not_implemented/not_applicable carry no Attempt - nothing has run, and that is a fact worth recording, not an omission. halted = Mechanical Failure awaiting an agent. failed = Assertion Failure, which no agent may fix. stale = passed under a superseded Template Version and re-queued.

blocked_on.description: Only meaningful when status is blocked, e.g. schumer_box_apply -> ["CSRV-5843", "CSRV-5844"].

attempts.description: Append-only, this Surface's own history. An earlier Attempt is never overwritten. Empty when status is blocked/not_applicable/not_implemented.

stage.description: Last completed step for THIS Surface. Also the resume point. cma uses the full applied/approved/issued/cma_rendered/asserted path; predecisioned_terms and the Schumer/landing Surfaces stop at read (no issuance, no render) before asserted.

handles.description: Captured by explicit id at creation. NEVER resolved later by recency - see AGENTS.md rule 1. cma and predecisioned_terms share the same application_id - see SKILL.md 'Choosing which Surface(s) to run'.

provenance.description: What this Attempt actually ran against. Without it a render cannot be attributed to an Epoch.

template_version.description: git_sha_version of the rendered CMA template. THE epoch signal. Never inferred from a fee amount. Null for Surfaces that render nothing.

class.description: mechanical: the apparatus broke; an agent may fix and resume. assertion: a result, never fixed by an agent. environment: invalidates every subsequent Run, so the whole Campaign stops.

diagnosis.description: The matching FINDINGS.md entry, quoted, by number.

interventions.description: Fixes an agent applied mid-Campaign. Surfaced in the artifact, and persisted into local-stack/ so they replay on later builds.
